name: Yamada Raita
source:
A prisoner of Team Death Dealing Duo. Sentence: 78 years.

Raita is the younger twin brother of Fuuta. He was convicted for murder and robbery. In contrast to his short fused older brother, he is calm and colected. Before being imprisoned, he was a genius employee at a firm. He claims that he was falsely accused, and works together with his twin brother aiming for his victory in the Yurukill games.
